senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Biram, also called Beth Baltin.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 23a">R. Hash. 23ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 23b:1">23ᵇ</cite>, a signal station for announcing the New Moon (betw. Syria and Mesopotamia, Neub. Géogr. p. 354).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:10">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>ועינא רבתי דב׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ועיניה</he>, corr. acc.) the Great (hot) Spring of B.; v. Hildesh. Beitr. z. Geogr. p. 29, note 206.
